details: Inspected current orchestrator, evidence store, Investigator, Iteration 1 verifier, advanced evaluator, CLI, and tests before changing the workflow.
Kept Advanced Iteration 1 intact and introduced a separate Iteration 2 path so historical comparison remains reproducible.
Added structured reproduction generation, retry feedback, JSON parsing, and AST-based blocking of obvious dangerous imports/calls.
Added original-first generated reproduction execution, bounded retry, same-test execution on patched code, evidence persistence, existing-suite execution, and evidence-constrained verdict generation.

Generated tests are written temporarily inside each controlled benchmark tree so local imports resolve, then removed immediately after execution; canonical generated source is retained in the evidence store.
Added explicit iteration selection and separate aggregate report directories for Iterations 1 and 2.
Made Iteration 2 the default advanced path while preserving --iteration 1; exposed reproduction-attempt controls and user-visible reproduction status.
Added tests for generated-test safety validation and a deterministic two-attempt reproduction retry workflow using a sequenced fake LLM.
Repository execution is not available in the coding-agent environment; local pytest and Ollama benchmark runs are required before the trace is closed.
